description: By Paul Hughes, WJAG — The One, Big, Beautiful Bill, signed into law by President Trump on the 4th of July provided funding for thousands of items, but did not address year-round sales of E-15. During a news conference earlier this week, Nebraska third-district Congressman Adrian Smith said the topic needs to be addressed at another time,

title: Smith leads the charge on E-15 – Adrian Smith for U.S. Congress
